decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ PATH{ NAME "client" }, SETTINGS{ NAME "delivery_policy" VALUE u16=0x0020 } } — bit 5 set: this subscriber requests the latched last value on join (RFC-0022 §5.2)
decoded.note: the producer carries no durability flag any more; the latch fires because THIS subscription asked for it, and not for a sibling subscription that did not
